summary: Arvinas, its subsidiaries, and Pfizer entered into a license agreement with Rigel Pharmaceuticals granting exclusive global rights to develop, manufacture, and commercialize VEPPANU (vepdegestrant), an oral PROTAC estrogen receptor degrader for ER+/HER2- advanced breast cancer. Rigel pays a $70M upfront, up to $40M in development contributions, a $15M transition payment, plus up to $320M in milestones and tiered mid-teens to mid-twenties royalties. All payments split evenly between Arvinas and Pfizer. This is an out-licensing deal, not a merger, acquisition, or restructuring. Watch for regulatory and commercialization milestones that trigger contingent payments.
